title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
Network Automation Engineer


We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and automate large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructure. This role blends deep network engineering expertise with modern automation and software development practices. You will work on high-availability internet and backbone networks, translating complex network designs into repeatable, programmatic templates and workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain carrier-grade network infrastructure supporting internet and backbone services
  • Engineer and support Cisco IOS XR–based platforms in production environments
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python scripting
  • Translate network designs, configurations, and standards into programmatic templates (Jinja2)
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management of network devices
  • Design and support VPN architectures and products, including troubleshooting and optimisation
  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance across large-scale networks
  • Participate in network design reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong background in network engineering and design
  • Hands-on experience with carrier-grade networks and internet infrastructure
  • Deep knowledge of Cisco IOS XR (configuration, troubleshooting, and operations)
  • Solid understanding of VPN technologies and products
  • Python scripting for network automation and tooling
  • Experience creating and managing Jinja2 templates for network configuration

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, C#, .NET or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;

title: Service Delivery Manager – Enterprise Support (Remote)
description:
About the company

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.

Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to take ownership of our service operations:

  • SLAs and incident processes
  • on‑call and skills coverage
  • SOPs and first‑line/SRE enablement
  • configuration management
  • SLA metrics and reporting
  • and coordination between customers and our engineering teams.

This is a hands‑on role , not a pure governance role. You will be close to real incidents, engineers, and customers and you’ll be expected to bring in practices you’ve already used successfully in previous service or managed‑services environments.


What you’ll do1. Service operations, on‑call & incidents
  • Design and maintain an on‑call and coverage plan that ensures all critical skills are available when needed (initially weekdays, evolving to full 24/7 where required).
  • Own the incident management process for your accounts: priorities, roles, communication cadence, escalations, and post‑incident reviews.
  • Define and monitor key service metrics (e.g., MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, backlog health) and drive improvements based on them.
  • Act as incident lead / coordinator during major incidents, keeping engineers focused and customers informed.


2. SOPs, runbooks & first‑line enablement
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and triage guides for SRE engineers, covering common incident types and operational tasks.
  • Train and coach first‑line/SRE teams so they can confidently handle initial triage, basic troubleshooting, and clear communication , escalating only when needed.
  • Continuously refine documentation based on real incident experience and feedback.


3. Configuration management & readiness
  • Establish and run a configuration management process that keeps track of each customer’s environment (platforms in use, clusters, regions, configs, access, monitoring, key contacts).
  • Proactively close information gaps by working directly with customers and engineers.
  • Ensure configuration information is available and trustworthy during incidents and for onboarding new engineers.


4. Customer communication & governance
  • Be the primary operational contact for a set of enterprise customers.
  • Lead regular service reviews and status calls , presenting SLA performance, key incidents, risks, and improvement actions.
  • Present and agree on the incident management process with customers (channels, priorities, escalation paths, expectations).
  • Work closely with Account Management / Sales on renewals, expansions, and expectation management.


5. Commercial & delivery management
  • Clarify what is in scope vs. out of scope and work with customers and Sales to shape paid change requests when additional work is needed.
  • Monitor effort vs. contract , help protect margins, and flag risks early (under‑scoped contracts, chronic over‑use, under‑utilized capacity).
  • Work in a matrix environment , coordinating with different technical teams (e.g., database engineering, DevOps, SRE) to staff and deliver engagements effectively.


6. Onboarding & training
  • Design and maintain onboarding paths for new engineers joining support/delivery (shadowing, training on SOPs, environment overviews, “certification” on certain incident types).
  • Ensure new team members reach a productive, independent state quickly and safely.


What success looks like in 6–12 months
  • On‑call coverage is clear, predictable, and sustainable ; engineers know when they’re on and what’s expected.
  • First‑line/SREs handle a meaningful share of incidents without escalation , using well‑maintained runbooks.
  • You can open a customer’s configuration, see an accurate picture, and use it during incidents and planning.
  • SLA and incident metrics are tracked, reported, and discussed regularly with customers and internally.
  • Customers have a clear understanding of how incidents are handled and feel confident in the process.
  • New engineers ramp up faster thanks to structured onboarding and training.


You’ll be a great fit if you have
  • 5+ years in a Service Delivery, Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support role serving external customers (not only internal IT).
  • Experience with 24/7 or extended‑hours operations , including on‑call or follow‑the‑sun setups.
  • Hands‑on experience with incident management and ITSM practices (incident/problem/change), ideally in an ITIL‑inspired environment.
  • A track record of creating or improving SOPs/runbooks and training first‑line / SRE teams.
  • Experience maintaining configuration / environment data for customer systems.
  • Comfort discussing technical topics with engineers (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and explaining them in clear business terms to customers.
  • Experience in commercial delivery : scope boundaries, change requests, effort vs. revenue, working alongside Sales / Account Management.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Background with data, analytics, or streaming platforms (e.g., Druid, Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, ClickHouse, TiDB, Hadoop, cloud data warehouses).
  • Experience working in small, fast‑moving, remote teams.


Location & working style
  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.
  • We are flexible on contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

  • Innovative Environment : Work on groundbreaking AI projects that have a real-world impact on industries such as security, finance, and energy. We pride ourselves on innovating through play and games, providing a safe environment to test many ideas and fail fast.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  • Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark \"Toxic\" in the \"Is toxic\" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark \"Normal\"
  • For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the \"Note\" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  • List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)


Requirements

  • Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  • Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  • Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  • Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  • Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus


Training & Payment

  • Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  • Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  • Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.


Additional Notes

  • The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  • Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

We are seeking a skilled Junior Developer to lead the creation of engaging, high-performance in-app community experiences aligned with major UK cultural moments. This role blends full-stack development with a deep understanding of online communities, culture, and data-driven iteration. You will own the full lifecycle of features—from concept to deployment—while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners to drive meaningful user engagement during peak activity periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the conceptualisation, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments.

  • Own the full development lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping through deployment and iteration.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the culture and technical needs of focus communities to inform content, feature sets, and engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to convert strategic growth goals and community feedback into clear technical requirements and deliverables.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .

General Requirements

  • Fluent in English , with a deep understanding of UK culture and language nuances.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple development and community launch cycles simultaneously.
  • Experience designing and executing community activations and interactive platform experiences.
  • Strong familiarity with large-scale online discussion platforms and user expectations.
  • Ability to quickly understand and adapt to diverse topics and content verticals.
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to community growth initiatives.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on high-impact community experiences tied to major cultural moments.

If you are passionate about building community-driven products and enjoy combining cultural insight with technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Profitable , +100M ARRR, + 1M MAUs, +8M clients, fintech accelerated in Silicon Valley needs you!

Help us improve the lives of 34 million workers in financial distress

We are a profitable, series A startup growing 10% MoM with more than $60M of annualized revenue helping workers without access to credit. We believe we can improve the lives of Brazilian workers offering salary advances.

We are invested by Monashees, ONEVC, and YCombinator. We believe a top-performing team is the most vital factor to a startup’s success.

Position: Chief of Staff

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO’s strategic partner—helping drive priorities, bring clarity and alignment across teams, and maximize effectiveness.

This is a career accelerator role: you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, with direct exposure to company decision-making, fundraising, growth, and operations. You’ll be embedded in the hardest challenges of scaling a high-growth fintech in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Your work will focus on three areas:

1. Strategic Execution & Decision Support

  • Partner with the CEO to prioritize and drive the most critical company-wide initiatives.
  • Dig into strategic questions—pricing, incentives, product-market fit, operational efficiency.
  • Generate high-leverage insights from data, market research, and direct user feedback.
  • Prepare decision frameworks, board materials, and briefing docs to enable fast, high-quality decisions.

2. Cross-Functional Alignment & Special Projects

  • Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, Finance, Credit and Operations—ensuring priorities are clear and execution sharp.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks, whether data gaps, misalignment, or process bottlenecks.
  • Drive high-impact special projects—ranging from new product launches to operational improvements.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, bringing an enterprise-wide perspective.

3. CEO Leverage & Investor Communications

  • Ensure the CEO’s time and focus are on the highest-leverage activities by filtering noise and structuring decisions.
  • Craft crisp, compelling communications—internal memos, board decks, investor updates, and team announcements.
  • Act as a sounding board: challenge assumptions, pressure-test ideas, and refine strategy.



Who You Are:

This role is for a sharp, driven, adaptable operator who thrives in ambiguity and wants a front-row seat to building a category-defining fintech.

You are:

  • A Strategic Thinker Who Executes: You break down complex problems into clear insights and actions. You anticipate second-order effects and make things happen.
  • A Strong Communicator & Influencer: You can synthesize complexity into clarity, influence across levels, and drive alignment.

Qualifications

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfort with SQL, Excel, Python and business metrics a plus.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional project execution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to take ownership and deliver results in unstructured environments.
Why This Role?
  • Unparalleled Exposure: Work side-by-side with a CEO who has scaled fintech to millions of users.
  • AI-native Company : We’re turning all departments into execution driven functions powered by LLMs and automation.
  • High-Impact Work: Tackle the most pressing strategic challenges at Brazil’s fastest-growing salary advance platform.
  • Career Acceleration: A launchpad into future leadership roles in fintech, strategy, or entrepreneurship.
  • Mission That Matters: Directly impact the financial lives of millions of Brazilian workers.
About us:

We are looking for an experienced Payments Product Operations Manager to improve efficiency, scalability, and innovation on our payments platform. This is a key role for someone passionate about streamlining operations and enhancing how digital financial products are delivered.


The Company

This fast-growing digital finance platform is transforming personal and business banking in the MENA region. Focused on modernising payments, it delivers seamless, customer-friendly solutions. With a culture of innovation, agility, and teamwork, the company values continuous improvement across all areas of the business.


What We’re Hiring

You will work across payments operations, collaborating with Product, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and external vendors to improve processes and performance. Key responsibilities include:


  • Optimise operations and implement process improvements.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to boost efficiency and scalability.
  • Support the development of new payment products and features.
  • Use data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Create dashboards and KPIs to track performance.


The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in payments or product operations, process optimisation.
  • Solid knowledge of payment systems, workflows, and regulations.
  • Track record of driving efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Skilled in collaborating with Product and Technology teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.


What’s in it for you:

  • Join a modern, fast-scaling fintech in the MENA region.
  • Work on products that are actively transforming how people invest.
  • Diverse, international, high-performance team.
  • Competitive package, bonuses + relocation package, hybrid working, generous holiday allowance.
  • High standard of life in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.


To apply, submit your application via this advert or email the consultant directly at .

We connect pioneering companies with highly skilled professionals across digital finance, emerging technologies, and decentralised systems.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora FullStack .NET e Angular ou React - Pleno

  • Experiencia com FrontEnd, Angular 2+ ou React;
  • Proficiência para novos desenvolvimentos e para entendimento de códigos existentes, bem como debugar aplicações e frontend na IDE e pelo F12 no browser;

  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps

Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;

title: Python/FastAPI Development
description:
Role- Python/FastAPI Development

Location-Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico

YoE - 4 + years

Engagement Length- 2 Months

Commitment Required

8 hours per day and 40 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Python Developer with strong expertise in FastAPI to join an exciting Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will design, build, and optimize scalable APIs, collaborate with researchers and engineers, and deliver high-quality backend services to support reinforcement learning experiments and simulations. Prior RL Gym experience is not mandatory but would be a plus.

What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design, build, and maintain FastAPI-based services for experimentation workflows and simulation environments.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to expose APIs for training, evaluation, and benchmarking.
  • Write efficient, production-grade Python code with a strong emphasis on scalability and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues, optimize pipelines, and ensure smooth deployment of applications.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional Python development experience including 3+ years of strong experience in FastAPI
  • Experience with REST APIs, async programming, and API lifecycle management.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (testing, CI/CD, version control, design patterns).
  • Familiarity with NumPy, Pandas, and PyTorch/TensorFlow is a plus.
  • Good to have: Exposure to Reinforcement Learning environments (OpenAI Gym, Gymnasium, Stable Baselines, or custom environments) & SQL experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

PO Foco: Definir, priorizar e manter o Product Backlog do projeto de DataViz, traduzindo as necessidades dos stakeholders e do cliente em histórias de usuário claras e critérios de aceitação.

Experiência Comprovada: experiência atuando como PMO, Gerente de Projetos ou Product Owner em projetos de alta complexidade e grande escala.

Metodologias: Forte conhecimento e experiência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou tradicionais (PMBOK).

Data & DataViz: Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de Data Visualization, Business Intelligence (BI) e Storytelling com dados. Capacidade de entender a estrutura de dados e como ela suporta a visualização final.

Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos, com experiência em interagir em nível executivo.

Who We Are

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject \"Senior ABAP Cloud Developer\". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker

  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

  • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events

  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:

  • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
  • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs

  • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations

title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
description:
Sr. Software Developer


Compensation: $19-22USD/hr

  • Paid two week company wide closure at calendar year end. 
  • 1 week paid time off per quarter - flexibility on timing based on team requirements
  • 1 paid Friday off monthly between February and November.

Employment type: Contractor - no additional benefits

Hours of operation: Preference between 9am-5pm EST


Our client wants you to join a startup-to-scaleup journey as a Senior Software Developer. In this fully remote role , you'll work on a schedule that ensures sufficient overlap with the core working hours of the EST timezone, you’ll be part of a team building new products that will be part of our assessments platform. You’ll build new systems, maintain existing systems, lead design , and mentor developers.


The systems you’ll work in are mostly JavaScript and TypeScript , though we have some new code in Go . New apps are React UIs that call well-defined APIs running on AWS API Gateway and Lambda and use NoSQL databases like DynamoDB .


The role is ideal for a quality-focused full-stack developer with strong technical proficiency who is looking to advance their career with a people-centric company that prioritizes work-life balance, invests in continuous growth, and builds products with meaningful social impact.


Client Overview


Our company was founded on the need for a higher education admissions method that looks beyond academic performance and considers the whole student—their unique qualities, experiences, and strengths. 


Today, our solutions help discover, nurture and realize people's potential, supporting holistic success from admissions to graduation for students, education programs, and higher education institutions across North America, the U.K., Australia, and Saudi Arabia.


Our core assessment product, provides education programs with a more holistic view of applicants by evaluating their soft skills. Incorporating insights into the admissions process results in a larger applicant pool, enables student success, and graduates better professionals. Since 2014, our software has been adopted by over 600 higher education programs, and more than 1 million applicants have registered to take the test.


With our core education program management solution, we help medical schools and other health professions programs optimize the complex processes and critical components of their curriculum and student assessments to generate data-driven insights needed to graduate competent future healthcare professionals. 


With our fast-growing data and insights solution, Analytics, we leverage critical integrations with our data warehouse and powerful dashboards to provide medical schools with deep insights and intelligence on student and program performance, powering real-time decision-making and continuous quality improvement.


What Skills Should You Bring?


  • 6+ years with backend JavaScript and TypeScript
  • 6+ years with Go and React
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and cloud platforms
  • Experience with AWS / MongoDB + Postgres


You need to be comfortable working on full-stack web applications. You can change UIs, APIs, database schemas, or deployment pipelines as needed. Ideally, you've worked on and led large system migrations. Preferably, you’ve experienced one migration that’s gone well (so you recognize success) but also one that was challenging (so you've learned from mistakes).


What Will You Work On?


Our team owns multiple new products that will be part of our assessments platform. We have initial projects underway but by no means is the plan fully defined. As a senior-level developer, you have opinions on design tradeoffs in this space and can articulate them in productive debates with the team, weighing short vs. long-term impact. You'll be the glue between leaders in Product and the rest of the development team. You'll work directly with product managers to prioritize features and improvements. It's essential that your technical perspective informs what's possible. Your opinions are as strong as the data you have to defend them.


Along the way, you will help guide our quality improvements. We expect you to be familiar with techniques and processes such as pair programming, code reviews, automated testing (unit/integration/end-to-end), feature flagging, monitoring, and alarming. We expect that you will mentor developers to adopt the practices that meet your quality expectations. We also expect that you can articulate the limits of these approaches and know what mix to use for any given problem.


As a Senior Developer it's crucial that you have strong written and verbal communication skills. You should have no problem discussing issues publicly on Slack, ensuring your reasoning is available to anyone when needed. Your project plans, status updates, high-level task summaries should be clear and easy reads. You will contribute all manner of system and architecture diagrams to the wiki to ensure the whole team is aligned with your technical vision. You also know when it’s time to hop on a video call to hash something out.


You're also adept at providing feedback. You can gauge where a developer is at and provide them with specific, actionable feedback to improve. Your commits and pull requests will set the high standard for other developers to follow. Your review comments will be written with empathy and tact where code quality could be improved to meet your professional standards.


Interview Process


Here are the steps you can expect:


  • Conversation with Recruiter. Have a 30-minute phone call during which you get to share your professional journey, career interests and assess initial skills.
  • Meet the Manager. Spend 45 minutes on a video call with your potential future manager. Discuss your relevant technical work experiences and learn in-depth about the day-to-day of the team and role. 
  • Asynchronous Code Review. A brief take-home project that offers you the opportunity to showcase your ability to give feedback and mentor other team members. 
  • Meet the Team & Showcase Your Technical Abilities. Meet with 3 more team members, a blend of technical and non-technical people, leaders, future peers and collaborators. You’ll meet 1-1 in a remote setting, go through live coding and system design exercises.

title: Paid Media Manager
description:
About Undetectable AI

Undetectable AI is a fast-growing AI company with 20M+ users worldwide, helping people create, refine, and adapt AI-generated content for work, education, and beyond. We’re obsessed with building tools that make AI content more useful, more human, and more effective, and we’re scaling fast. To fuel our next stage of growth, we’re hiring a Paid Ads Manager to own and scale our multi-channel paid acquisition.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on, deeply technical, and highly data-driven Paid Ads Manager who will own all paid campaigns across our main platforms:

  • Google Ads
  • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Bing Ads
  • Snapchat Ads
  • TikTok Ads
  • Reddit Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • X (Twitter) Ads


You’ll be responsible for planning, launching, optimizing, and scaling campaigns across these channels with clear goals:

  • Hit and improve CAC targets
  • Maintain a strong ROAS
  • Scale spend aggressively where it makes sense
  • Build systems so we can grow consistently


This is not a “manage the agency” role. This is a full-ownership, IC role: you will be inside the ad accounts every day.


What You’ll Do

1. Own Multi-Channel Paid Acquisition

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across Google, Meta, Bing, Snapchat, TikTok, Reddit, LinkedIn, and X Ads.
  • Build campaign structures (search, performance max, display, video, social, retargeting) aligned with growth goals.
  • Maintain a daily pulse on performance: spend, CAC, ROAS, CVR, LTV trends.

2. Hit Targets on CAC, ROAS & Scale

  • Continuously optimize campaigns to drive CAC down while scaling volume up.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to increase budgets where performance is strong.
  • Make clear, data-backed recommendations when to cut, when to push, and when to pause.

3. Attribution, Tracking & Data Integrity

  • Ensure clean, reliable tracking across all platforms.
  • Work with devs on Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion events, and server-side tracking where relevant.
  • Collaborate on attribution using tools like Hyros, Triple Whale, and platform-level data to make smart decisions.
  • Validate that events are firing correctly and that campaigns are attributed as accurately as possible.

4. Funnel Strategy

  • Design and manage full-funnel paid strategies:
  • Top of funnel: cold audiences who don’t know us yet
  • Middle of funnel: users who are aware / engaged but haven’t converted
  • Bottom of funnel & remarketing: users who visited, signed up, or engaged with our content but haven’t upgraded
  • Match messaging, offers, and creatives to the right stage in the user journey.

5. Creative, Copy & Testing

  • Write and/or improve ad copy for search and social.
  • Collaborate with design and video teams to brief and iterate creatives (hooks, angles, formats).
  • Continuously test:
  • Headlines, descriptions, and CTAs
  • Creatives (images, video, UGC-style, carousels, etc.)
  • Audiences, placements, and bidding strategies
  • Document learnings and scale winning patterns across platforms.

6. Analytics, Reporting & Systems

  • Build clear reporting spreadsheets and dashboards to track:
  • Spend, ROAS
  • CAC by channel, campaign, and funnel stage
  • Trials, and paid conversions
  • Turn data into actionable insights and next steps, not just charts.
  • Create repeatable systems for:
  • New campaign creation
  • Weekly optimization cycles
  • Performance reviews
  • Reporting to leadership

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
  • Dev team: to implement and troubleshoot tracking, pixels, and events
  • Design team: to ship high-performing creatives fast
  • Marketing & product teams: to align offers, landing pages, and messaging with user needs
  • Be highly responsive on Slack and proactive in communication. We do daily calls.

8. Innovation & Best Practices

  • Stay ahead of ad platform changes, algorithm shifts, and trends in performance marketing and SaaS user acquisition.
  • Bring new ideas to the table: new channels, new betas, new creative frameworks, new funnel experiments.
  • Turn what works into playbooks and internal best practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on, end-to-end experience managing paid ads (strategy, setup, optimization, reporting).
  • Proven experience managing over six-figure monthly ad spend across multiple platforms.
  • Strong background in SaaS user acquisition.
  • Deep experience with Google Ads & SEM (search, PMax, brand & non-brand, keyword strategy, negative keyword structure, etc.).
  • Strong experience with: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, Bing, X Ads.
  • Solid understanding of attribution and experience with tools like Hyros, Triple Whale, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with Google Tag Manager, pixels, and platform-specific tracking setups, in collaboration with devs.
  • Strong data and analytics skills: can read numbers, spot patterns, build basic spreadsheets, and draw conclusions without hand-holding.
  • Demonstrated ability to write effective ad copy and give creative direction for social ads.
  • Proficient with project management and collaboration tools like ClickUp, Google Drive, etc.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills; responds quickly and clearly on Slack. Is available for calls.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).


Mindset & How You Work

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is extremely data-driven. Decisions are made from the numbers.
  • Is accountable for results, not just tasks. You care about CAC, ROAS, revenue, and growth.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment: priorities move, opportunities pop up, you adapt fast.
  • Is curious and proactive: constantly learning, testing, and bringing new ideas.
  • Has high ownership: you own the results of your work and responsibilities.
  • Balances strategy + execution: you can think at a systems level but also love getting your hands dirty in the ad accounts.


What Success Looks Like

  • CAC and ROAS targets are consistently met and improved across main channels.
  • We have stable, scalable campaigns running across multiple platforms.
  • There’s a clear system for:
  • Launching new campaigns
  • Optimizing existing ones
  • Testing creatives, audiences, and funnels
  • Dashboards and reports give us clear visibility into performance.
  • We’re seeing measurable growth in users and revenue attributable to paid.


Benefits:

  • A competitive salary and the freedom to work remotely from anywhere
  • The chance to collaborate with a globally distributed team of ambitious, high-performing individuals
  • 10 days of PTO annually—because rest fuels excellence
  • An all-expenses-paid regional offsite each year to connect, align, and celebrate as a team
  • A culture built on ownership, velocity, and personal growth—where your ideas move fast and your impact is real

description:

  • Ability to support and advise engineering teams on AWS architectural components such as Redis, EventBridge, AWS Glue, and AWS Bedrock.
  • Comfortable acting as a technical escalation point, providing AWS support via Slack when primary leads are unavailable.
  • Experience creating technical estimates and cost projections for new infrastructure requirements.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • AWS Account & Infrastructure Management: Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Security & Compliance: Monitor WAF configurations, manage certificate renewals via AWS Certificate Manager, and oversee ECR for Docker image vulnerabilities.
  • Multi-Cloud Support: Execute specific GCP-related tasks and manage Azure AD / SSO authentication configurations.
  • Tooling Administration: Manage access and billing for engineering tools, including Cursor and Code Rabbit.
  • CI/CD Operations: Provision new pipelines, investigate failures or performance issues, and update pipelines to support new functionality.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve AWS CDK infrastructure to support new client and product features.
  • Docker Management: Maintain and optimize the internal Docker repository.
  • Observability & Reliability: Configure and maintain monitoring dashboards, optimize alert thresholds, and analyze AWS DevOps Guru insights.
  • Incident Diagnosis: Investigate health issues, diagnose production errors, analyze logs, and perform load testing as needed.
  • Service Monitoring: Monitor AWS SES reputation and overall service health.
  • Consultation & Support: Act as the primary AWS escalation point via Slack and advise teams on cloud architecture decisions.
  • Estimations & Planning: Produce technical estimates and cost projections for new infrastructure initiatives.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

title: Recruiter
description:

Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.
